market_notes.value: Georgia has barred local rent regulation since 1984 (O.C.G.A. 44-7-19) - no caps in Atlanta or anywhere in the state. Fulton County assessor GIS hub documented for bulk parcels.

office.note: Colliers Q2 2026: vacancy eased to ~18% from a 26% peak (narrative round figure — carried as stated); Class A asking $35.86/SF with >5% YoY growth for a third straight quarter; sublease availability under 5.0M SF for the first time since Q4 2021. Stabilizing on HQ demand.

industrial.note: Q2 2026: CBRE direct 8.2% vs JLL 9.0% (4.4M SF absorbed) — spread carried. Rents cluster tightly: Cushman $7.53 direct all-product (warehouse/distribution $7.38), JLL $7.43. Pressure concentrated in smaller-format and legacy product.

multifamily.note: Reads span Northmarq 5.6% (lowest in nearly three years, expected to reach 5.2%) to a CRE Daily brief's 7.2% declining — spread carried. M&M 2Q26: deliveries slowing 43% YoY (9,300 units, +1.6% inventory), rents ~$1,600 (+1% — among the stronger early-2026 metros). Cap reads conflict by construct (5.2% A/B average vs low-to-mid-5s deal narrative vs a 5.5-6.0 aggregator quote) — no single band carried.

multifamily.note: Northmarq Q1 2026: occupancy 93.2% (+10bps) = 6.8% vacancy; absorption ~8,500 units vs ~7,500 delivered; pipeline 43% below the 2023 peak. Average metro rent $1,482 (-3.0% YoY) while Class A rose 3.2% YoY for a fifth straight quarter — the mix, not a contradiction. A templated aggregator line quoting 4.6% was rejected (same boilerplate seen on another metro's page). No. 1 metro for absolute population growth (+100k residents YoY).
